jobs.title: Research Fellow - Curtin Centre for Applied Ethics
jobs.fitReason: Trustworthy AI, digital transformation, quantitative analysis and research translation overlap, but the role is primarily applied ethics/social-policy research rather than technical AI/ML.

jobs.title: Senior Lecturer / Associate Professor
jobs.fitReason: AI/ML, computer-vision and teaching themes align, but the advertised senior academic level expects a substantially stronger established research, funding and leadership record than the current early-career profile.

jobs.title: Lecturer/Senior Lecturer in Robotics and Mechatronic Engineering
jobs.fitReason: AI/computer-vision and teaching skills transfer, but the position specifically expects a robotics/mechatronics PhD and research record in that field.

jobs.title: Research Fellow in Power Systems Engineering
jobs.fitReason: Quantitative modelling, optimisation, open-source code and reproducible research skills transfer, but the role requires a completed PhD and a research profile in electrical power systems, DER/inverter control and distribution networks.

jobs.title: Senior Lecturer/Lecturer, Business Technology and Analytics
jobs.fitReason: AI, analytics and digital-technology themes fit, with useful teaching experience, but the role is Level C/business-school oriented and expects a more established academic leadership profile.

jobs.title: Research Fellow in Energy Systems
jobs.fitReason: Near-completion PhD, quantitative modelling, Python/data analysis and interdisciplinary research transfer well, but the role is centred on energy-system optimisation, infrastructure delivery and energy-market domain knowledge rather than AI/ML.

jobs.title: Research Fellow, Technology Adoption & Social Change, ARC Research Hub IC-SensE
jobs.fitReason: Responsible AI, data security and human-AI themes overlap, but the mandatory social-sciences PhD and qualitative research methodology are major mismatches.

jobs.title: Research Fellow
jobs.fitReason: Strong computational research, optimisation and programming skills transfer to the project, but quantum complexity, quantum algorithms and quantum sensing are substantial domain gaps.

jobs.title: Research Fellow in Stochastic Multiscale Modelling in Biology
jobs.fitReason: Near-completion PhD, Bayesian/statistical modelling and computational research skills transfer, but the role specifically expects stochastic processes, multiscale mathematical modelling and an applied-mathematics/probability background.

jobs.title: Research Fellow, Computational Systems Modelling for Road Safety
jobs.fitReason: Solid computational modelling, data analysis and research-method transferability, but human factors, systems thinking and road-safety modelling are outside the core research profile.

jobs.title: Postdoctoral Research Fellow - Cancer Epigenomics, Bioinformatics & AI
jobs.fitReason: Strong AI/ML, Python, statistical analysis and complex-data research alignment with near-completion PhD accepted; the main gap is direct single-cell, spatial-omics and cancer-bioinformatics experience.

jobs.title: Postdoctoral Fellow in Bayesian Computation
jobs.fitReason: Good statistical machine-learning, Python and reproducible research transferability, but the role is specifically centred on Bayesian computation and computational statistics and requires a completed relevant PhD.

jobs.title: Lecturer (Education Focused) in Business Analytics
jobs.fitReason: Exceptional match to a near-completion Computer Science PhD with AI/ML, data science, Python, LLM and substantial tertiary teaching experience; the main gap is less direct business/financial-services analytics and R experience.

jobs.title: Postdoctoral Research Fellow in Power System Stability
jobs.fitReason: Some data-driven modelling overlap, but the essential expertise is electrical engineering, power electronics, power-system stability and hardware/HIL validation.

jobs.title: Senior Research Fellow - Health AI Implementation
jobs.fitReason: Direct health-AI and trustworthy/equitable technology themes overlap, but the role is senior and strongly expects a completed health/HCI-related doctorate plus qualitative or mixed-method implementation research rather than technical ML development.

jobs.title: Postdoctoral Fellow
jobs.fitReason: Computer science and machine-learning applications are allowed, but the project specifically requires research experience in category theory, which is not a core strength in the current profile.

jobs.title: Lecturer – Information Technology | International Delivery
jobs.fitReason: Strong fit to IT/AI teaching, curriculum development and higher-education delivery, but the role requires a completed PhD and an annual 18-week teaching semester in China.
